1.title: Prosecutors Examined Firm With Tie to Judge in Trump Hush Money Trial
1.summary: The U.S. attorney in Chicago subpoenaed a fund-raising firm that had been co-owned by the daughter of Judge Juan Merchan, who conducted the trial that led to Donald Trump’s felony conviction.

2.title: What Is Happening at the Border in Big Bend National Park?
2.summary: Over the objections of environmentalists, local sheriffs and some state leaders, the Trump administration appears to be moving ahead with border infrastructure in one of Texas’ most beloved parks.

3.title: As China Pushes to Expand in Asia, Trump Focuses on Iran
3.summary: Asian allies are beginning to wonder whether the United States would or could defend them in a war.

4.title: Family stranded at sea for 16 hours after jet ski capsized in Thailand
4.summary: A father and his two young sons spent a night adrift before being rescued off the coast of the island of Koh Samui.

5.title: Professor’s Death Leaves Behind Hard Questions for Cambridge on Race and Hiring
5.summary: Jason Arday, the school’s youngest Black professor, was found dead on Friday. The school ignored a series of warnings about his life story and his work.

6.title: South Korea proposes talks to officially end war with North
6.summary: Lee Jae Myung offers chance to end the conflict, which has been frozen since an armistice in 1953.
